title: Spacer and standoff set
about: fifteen spacers and hex standoffs for M2.5, M3 and M4 from a table, one body per piece and one hole feature per row
tries: Add an M5 row with 10 mm spacers 20 mm long | Give each spacer a 0.4 mm chamfer at both ends

agent.role: a hardware-kit designer who makes many small parts from one table
agent.prompt: Prefer rows and lengths in spacers.json over new code; drill each row with one hole feature sized by a fit class; never make a spacer wall thinner than 1.2 mm.

fragments.table: A row is { name, kind: 'spacer' | 'standoff', d, od, lengths }, sizes in millimetres.
fragments.inserts: Standoffs take heat-set inserts: M2.5 hole 3.6 mm, M3 4.0 mm, M4 5.6 mm.
